tests: R8 (T45) (a) a breach action rests on a live determination noncompliant for a standard it names; (b) a void one is refused through conformance R33; asked superseded, void, not noncompliant, per leg
R8 (T45) (e) a success record consequences reads superseded (live false, a successor named) is no basis: ACTION_BASIS_REFUSED, nothing written
R8 (T45) (d) an overridden action may later gain a leg on a live noncompliant determination: the override stays, the read answers both; (e) a rests_on leg may name a live success record

R74 the override is {ground, reason}: each ground lands; none, or another kind, is OVERRIDE_NO_GROUND with both grounds and the quick route; a malformed ground OVERRIDE_GROUND_REFUSED; a machine states none; one written before T45 reads ground null
R75 the read answers disclosures: one per distinct held check and per distinct accepted source edition, and the override's; published findings carry none
R76 the read and actionsFor (basis_void: true) answer basis_void for each void rests_on determination, derived on read; an action over one not void answers []
R9 (T45) a press addressee may carry holder, kept inside the group: the read and actionsFor only; on another arm COUNTERPARTY_REFUSED; the venue's delivery point beside an office addressee
R77 copied offices: a list lands; the addressee copied is COPIED_IS_ADDRESSEE; a person COUNTERPARTY_REFUSED; a machine MACHINE_CANNOT_SET_COPIED; copied offices are never addressees (R67)
R78 partners: organisations by role, stated by a member; an entity naming a person or no organisation PARTNERS_REFUSED; shown in the read; a machine MACHINE_CANNOT_SET_PARTNERS
R79 press terms on a press action, stated by a member; each change appended to press_terms_history; on another arm PRESS_TERMS_NOT_PRESS; a machine MACHINE_CANNOT_SET_PRESS_TERMS
R94 a sent entry may state its speaker, a member, stated by a member; several speakers on one action land; a non-member CONTACT_NOT_A_MEMBER; never in R66's items
R25 the read answers the receipts action-records records (its R4, was R80), oldest first (K2845), and the entry is never rewritten; its op is served by action-records' map (R103)

R81 a received entry with an outcome may carry office_status, its status of the view's response statuses for the kind; OFFICE_STATUS_UNKNOWN, OFFICE_STATUS_WITHOUT_OUTCOME; the fixed outcome is never replaced
R82 reply_owed: false, set by a member with a reason, each change in its history; while false a no_response is NO_REPLY_OWED and the read says so; absent reads owed
R83 a received entry may state found_elsewhere, held as a capture: no responds_to edge is added; without one FOUND_ELSEWHERE_NEEDS_CAPTURE; the same entry without it adds the edge
R85 a records request's stage not in its law's listed stages is STAGE_NOT_IN_LAW; a listed stage lands; with no list it lands and reads undetermined
R86 follows_action: stated on creation, naming a visible action other than itself; never changed; the read answers follows_action and followed_by; actionsFor takes follows

R95 registerResponseListener: one per module; each listener called once after a received entry is promoted, with the action, entry, project, recorder and date; a throw never undoes it; a sent entry or a refused write calls none

R66 R25 R30 (T47) confidential is read through action-records.confidential (its R5, was R87): a confidential action is not answered by R66, is answered again once removed, and the read and actionsFor answer it
R25 every viewer who sees the action reads the promises action-records records (its R6, was R88), standing apart from ended

R92 openItemsWith: the visible open actions to the same office (entity id, else role and body), each with its first sent date and overdue reply, and their count; a non-office answers none with its sentence; an action to another office is not listed
R93 a recognition (the view's shape: recognition) answers recognition_basis: compliant, success or promise_only with its sentence; nothing is refused for it

R97 at start actions registers once with consequences.registerOwnActReader and standards.registerOwnSendingCheck; each answers the group's own acts and sendings, names back only what it was given; an id of no action is not answered
R10 the kinds read the group's governing view (local-facts R12): with no group rule, byte-identical to combine's; with no profile, the product's alone
